scope.market_definition: The medical devices distribution market in India involves the supply chain of medical devices from manufacturers to healthcare providers. Participants include distributors, wholesalers, and retailers who facilitate the availability of various medical devices across hospitals and clinics in the country.

value_chain_layers.description: This layer includes the production of medical devices by manufacturers.
This layer covers the distribution of medical devices to healthcare facilities.
This layer includes retail outlets that sell medical devices directly to consumers.
